title: Find the largest value
instructions: Repair largest_value(numbers) so it returns the largest integer in the list. Keep the function name and parameter unchanged.
constraints: numbers is a nonempty list containing between 1 and 100 integers.
Return the largest value; do not print it.
Do not modify the input list.
hints: Check what happens when every number is negative.
What assumption does initializing best to zero make?
The list is guaranteed to be nonempty. Can an existing element provide the initial value?
